title: Sellers et al. (2015): Couple free 4-ATP to NHS-CdS

productContexts.label: CdS bearing the amide-linked dithiol ligand
notes: Free 4-ATP coupling produces a ligand-functionalized CdS specimen; it is not a CdS/CdSe heterostructure.

scopeLabel: Main-only scoped synthesis, ligand exchange, coupling, controls and analytical preparation review. All 12 main pages were read as text and images. Locally present supporting information remains held and unreviewed; its additional plots, fit tables and energy-level derivation are excluded. Representative characterization contexts are not exact synthesis-batch assignments. No complete-paper Reader.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
